content.scenario: The Central Authority requires funding to carry out its functions, including regulating consumer markets and enforcing consumer rights. The Central Government must provide grants to the Central Authority to support its activities.
content.outcome: The Central Government must make grants of money to the Central Authority, after due appropriation made by Parliament by law. This funding is essential for the Central Authority to perform its functions effectively.

user_queries: How is the Central Authority funded?
What is the role of Parliament in funding the Central Authority?
Can the Central Government withhold funding from the Central Authority?
